requirements.title: World feed streams real swarm signals
requirements.description: WorldService.StreamWorldFeed opens with a snapshot of active runs and upcoming heartbeats and streams run started/finished/failed, heartbeat upcoming/cancelled and agent messages from the run registry and scheduler; the UI falls back to the 5 s poll when the stream is silent or failing.

validation.notes: Snapshot first, then RUN_STARTED and RUN_FAILED with the error over a real Connect stream
Ring replay by seq, slow-subscriber drop, subscriber cleanup on cancel
Polling starts within fallbackAfterMs when the stream fails and stops when it recovers

requirements.title: World terrain is generated from one seed
requirements.description: When a world seed is supplied, the system shall deterministically generate one height field, moisture field, water mask, biome grid, and terrain digest from that seed.

validation.notes: Seeded height and moisture fields are deterministic and bounded
Water, shore clearance, and navigation are derived from the terrain field
Every terrain cell receives one deterministic biome
